visualConventions.bounds: Green circles for algorithms, red diamonds for lower bounds.
visualConventions.setupColors: Blue query halos, violet communication halos, gold list-input halo; colors do not encode the bound direction.
visualConventions.axes: Query plots show leading n-power; exact log factors and quantifiers are explicit. Pair graph shows Δ=n^α and leading exponent 2−α. Degeneracy lower coordinate fixes λ>1. Communication uses separate metric columns.
visualConventions.zoom: No text at overview; compact removes details; detail restores formulas and key scope notes.
